}}'''Vram Torkumen''' was a [[Saldaean]] noble, a cousin to queen [[Tenobia si Bashere Kazadi|Tenobia]], and a [[Darkfriend]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Vram Torkumen}}

==History==
Lord Torkumen is a distant cousin of both [[Lord]] [[Davram Bashere]] and [[Queen]] [[Tenobia Kazadi]]. He had a wife, [[Lady Torkumen]].

==Activities==
Lord Torkumen delayed aid to [[Rodel Ituralde]]'s army in defending [[Maradon]] against an invading [[Trolloc]] army. Eventually, Ituralde's forces were permitted into the city at the latest possible moment.{{ref/book|13|24}} Ituralde visits him with [[Yoeli]] and names him Darkfriend. 
They were subsequently joined by [[Rand al'Thor]], who single-handily decimated the invading Trolloc Army. Upon Rand's channeling, Vram and his wife [[Lady Torkumen]] were revealed to be Darkfriends. His wife threw herself out the window while Vram clawed out his own eyes.{{ref/book|13|32}}
